messages.text: Sourcing request: Stockline is now 0.04 a stock check (data 5 s old, margin 0.01 at our 0.05 price, 13 of last 20 paid). Our per-purchase cap is 0.03, so Stockline is blocked. Ridgeline (0.02, 10-min-old data) is unavailable on 12 of its last 20 tries, so fill rate is poor. Could the CFO raise the per-purchase cap to 0.04 so Stockline can serve queries? Budget left is 9.86. I would keep max price at 0.04 and not exceed it.

Your cap request has gone to the CFO as P-0001 (A) and P-0002 (B). Both raise your per-purchase cap to 0.04 and your budget to 14.00 (4.00 moved from Treasury). A keeps the query price at 0.05, which leaves a 0.01 margin. B, which I recommended, raises it to 0.07, which leaves a 0.03 margin. Until the CFO approves, stay within the 0.03 cap and use Ridgeline.
